arguments.description: One static 16 by 16 pixel-art UI status icon communicating successful completion (Ready), shared by full and compact queue cells. Propose a simple clear checkmark silhouette as the first representative sample, not an already approved style. Transparent background. Use the existing UI cool blue accent; #70b9ed from the preserved Start vector is a color cue, not a mandatory exact palette. No fixed palette. Prioritize readable silhouette and deliberate pixel clusters/edges at native 1x and nearest-neighbor 3x on dark panel #172336. The completion meaning should read clearly rather than activity, failure/retry or pause; later family comparison will confirm distinctions when those assets exist. Single standalone icon, one frame, for assets/ready.png; do not draw the panel, label, Start control, activity loop, retry or paused assets. No approved style image exists; this is a direction proposal for review.
